run_evaluate_binaural_audio: run the evaluation script to compute STFT L2 and envelope distance metrics for predicted binaural audio against ground truth
run_evaluate_mono_audio: run the evaluation script with --real_mono flag to evaluate mono audio predictions replicated to binaural channels
run_evaluate_with_normalization: run the evaluation script with --normalization flag to normalize predicted and ground truth audio before computing distance metrics
run_evaluate_custom_sampling_rate: run the evaluation script with a custom --audio_sampling_rate to evaluate audio at a non-default sampling rate
run_evaluate_stft_l2_distance: run the STFT_L2_distance function to compute the mean squared difference between predicted and ground truth spectrograms across both channels
